fusions.name: Fistful of Collar
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and stabs it: deals 14 damage, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Overarm Fling
fusions.desc: Hurls a knife overarm at a target up to 7 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Whittled Stakes
fusions.desc: Hides sharpened stakes at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Leverage

riders.text: the blade keeps pace with the fist
and the bulk is never where it looked
and the ground between is crossed in a bound

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you attack 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 4%, and from gold you move 5% faster.
